text:
Predicates:
BreedingBack(x) ::: x is a form of artificial selection by deliberate selective breeding of domestic animals.
BredBack(x, y) ::: x were bred-back in year y.
HeckCattle(x) ::: x is Heck cattle.
Aurochs(x) ::: x is an aurochs.
Animal(x) ::: x is an animal.
Resemble(x, y) ::: x resembles y.
Extinct(x) ::: x is extinct.

Premises:
BreedingBack(breedingBack) ::: Breeding back is a form of artificial selection by the deliberate selective breeding of domestic animals.
BredBack(heckCattle, 1920s) ∧ Resemble(heckCattle, aurochs) ::: Heck cattle were bred-back in the 1920s to resemble the aurochs.
HeckCattle(heckCattle) ∧ Animal(heckCattle) ::: Heck cattle are animals.
Aurochs(aurochs) ∧ Animal(aurochs) ::: Aurochs are animals.
∃x ∃y (Animal(x) ∧ Extinct(y) ∧ Resemble(x, y) ∧ BreedingBack(x)) ::: Some animals to be bred-back resemble animals that are extinct.

Conclusion:
Extinct(aurochs) ::: Aurochs are extinct.
